mapper.select: select m.* from km_media m join km_collection_item i on i.media_id = m.media_id where i.collection_id = #{collectionId} and m.del_flag = '0' order by i.sort asc, i.id asc

select m.*, i.sort as _i_sort, i.id as _i_id from km_media m join km_collection_item i on i.media_id = m.media_id
i.collection_id = #{collectionId} and m.del_flag = '0' and m.title like concat('%', #{q.title}, '%') and m.media_type = #{q.mediaType} and m.region like concat('%', #{q.region}, '%') and m.genres like concat('%', #{q.genres}, '%') and year(m.release_date) = #{q.year}
and m.vote_average >= #{q.minRating} and m.rating_avg >= #{q.minRating} and (m.rating_avg >= #{q.minRating} or (coalesce(m.rating_avg, 0) = 0 and m.vote_average >= #{q.minRating}))
and exists (select 1 from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id
and (
r.platform like concat(#{pn}, '%')
)
and r.platform = #{q.platform} and r.offer_type = #{q.offerType} )
and ( coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) > curdate() or m.status in ('Planned', 'In Production', 'Post Production') )
and ( (m.media_type = 'tv' and m.status = 'Returning Series') or (m.media_type = 'movie' and coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) <= curdate() and coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 60 day)) )
and ( (m.media_type = 'tv' and m.status in ('Ended', 'Canceled')) or (m.media_type = 'movie' and coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) is not null and coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) < date_sub(curdate(), interval 60 day)) )
order by ( (coalesce(m.vote_count,0) + coalesce(m.rating_count,0)) * coalesce(nullif(m.rating_avg,0), m.vote_average, 0) + 25 * 6.3 ) / (coalesce(m.vote_count,0) + coalesce(m.rating_count,0) + 25) desc, (coalesce(m.vote_count,0) + coalesce(m.rating_count,0)) desc order by m.popularity desc, m.hot_score desc order by coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) desc order by m.create_time desc order by i.sort asc, i.id asc

select coalesce(m.poster_local_url, m.poster_path) from km_media m join km_collection_item i on i.media_id = m.media_id where i.collection_id = #{collectionId} and m.del_flag = '0' and (m.poster_local_url is not null or m.poster_path is not null) order by i.sort asc, i.id asc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from km_collection_item where collection_id = #{collectionId} and media_id = #{mediaId}
mapper.insert: insert into km_collection_item (collection_id, media_id, sort, note, create_time) values (#{collectionId}, #{mediaId}, ifnull(#{sort},0), #{note}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from km_collection_item where collection_id = #{collectionId} and media_id = #{mediaId}
